svg.text: talk.01 · v0.4 study · THE WHOLE LOWER HALF IS ONE COVER PLATE
a lid with a pattern over a round hole · four patterns · controls above (key upper-left, wheel in the top-right corner)
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
front views at 10 mm = 42 px
G1 RIDGES
horizontal relief ridges · SAND
· The old-radio classic. The round hole shows
where the gaps go through to the dark.
· Risk: the nearest to your first reference;
keep our own proportions, colour and the
control zone above.
G2 TALL RIDGES
vertical relief ridges · POPPY
· Same idea turned 90 degrees: reads as a
speaker slat, and prints without bridging
over long spans.
· Risk: vertical ridges in red next to a red
key may be too much red.
G3 GRID
square grid · SAND
· A square grid over the round hole (like your
third picture): the circle appears behind
the mesh.
· Risk: fine grids are slow to print and may
string; larger squares help.
G4 DOTS
dot matrix · SAND
· Dark plate, tiny dimples outside the circle
and real holes inside it: the dot-matrix
look of your second picture.
· Risk: the darkest option; many small holes
to print.
A RIDGED PLATE (section, a sketch)
ridges 1.4 mm tall, rounded
slots through only over the hole
felt behind the plate
MEMS mic, port towards the hole
The plate is one lid:
· four corner screws; it comes off. That makes
patterns swappable and lets us test the sound with
and without a plate (the 'removable cover system'
already in the backlog).
· over the hole the gaps go through; elsewhere the
ridges, grid or dots are relief only, so the plate
is stiffer and prints easier.
· print it face up so the ridges build upward.
Whether a 1.1 mm gap prints cleanly on your
printer is untested.
· the plate is the part your hand rests on, so
ridges are rounded (0.4 mm or more) and run across
the grip.
About the pictures you sent:
· I used them for the idea only: a cover over a
round hole; relief ridges, dots, a grid.
· The first carries a 'TING FX' mark and a site
watermark; I have not checked who made it. No
shapes are copied: our proportions, our control
zone, colours and graphics differ, and the plate
is a separate lid.
· The pictures are not stored in the repository.
